title: My MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central Administration now supports handling PTEs.
summary: An MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central Administration now supports per-tenant extensions (PTEs), allowing users to upload, monitor deployment status, and uninstall PTEs from AI clients like GitHub Copilot through sequential processing that prevents concurrent deployment errors.
key_points: Upload single or multiple per-tenant extensions from local .app files or folders to Business Central environments
Monitor extension deployment status in real-time with configurable polling intervals and maximum wait times
Sequential processing prevents concurrent deployment conflicts and ensures each extension completes before the next starts
Comprehensive reporting summarizes successes, failures, and per-file status for batch operations
features: Upload per-tenant extension from local file
Upload multiple per-tenant extensions from folder

quotes.text: With the latest 1.1.1 version, my MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central Administration fully supports handling PTEs in your customer tenants.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core capability and scope of the update for administrators managing per-tenant extensions

quotes.text: Sequential Processing: Uploads and installs extensions one at a time, preventing "another operation running" errors that can occur with concurrent deployments.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the key technical advantage that solves a real problem administrators face with simultaneous PTE deployments
